hypothesis: Isolating exhaustiveness yields a more usable judgment than asking fidelity of a mostly correct candidate with an incorrect only qualifier.

source.quote:
(b) In case of an
emergency, a landlord may enter the dwelling unit or any portion of the
premises under a tenant’s exclusive control without consent of the tenant,
without notice to the tenant and at any time. “Emergency” includes but is not
limited to a repair problem that, unless remedied immediately, is likely to
cause serious damage to the premises. If a landlord makes an emergency entry in
the tenant’s absence, the landlord shall give the tenant actual notice within
24 hours after the entry, and the notice shall include the fact of the entry,
the date and time of the entry, the nature of the emergency and the names of
the persons who entered.

legacy_anchor.question: Does this definition limit emergencies to the repair situation it describes?
legacy_anchor.classification: exposed diagnostic anchor; not fresh evidence

fresh_selection.selection_rule: Use new complete primary-source definitions not present in either prior diagnostic. Preserve exact spans and source identity, recover scope/cross-references before labeling. Select the precise list or category whose exhaustiveness is judged; do not label every means clause closed or every includes clause open by string matching.
fresh_selection.labels: Independent source reviewer fixes truth and reasoning before any responses; uncertain scope is repaired before dispatch, not dropped after scores.

question_contract.question: Does the definition restrict the selected term to the listed categories?
state: complete source definition and necessary governing scope
question_contract.license: Only whether this selected list is exhaustive for this term in this scope. It does not establish a full definition, membership of any concrete scenario, applicability or operational permission.
question_contract.ambiguity_handling: If multiple lists are present, identify exactly one. Do not infer unknown context means an open definition.

matched_design.control: Use the same source and independently determined meaning across matched cells. Do not mix a grouping change into a wording comparison. Randomize/counterbalance job order, preserve actual groups and all outputs. If repetitions are used, predeclare them and keep all trials.
matched_design.freshness: These are fresh source selections for a development test, not heldout validation of a final contract. Keep exposed OR emergency as separate anchor.

analysis: Keep.1/.9 thresholds fixed; report expected established, opposite established and abstained separately by configuration and source stratum.
Compare paired outcomes descriptively; do not treat all questions across the same source as independent observations.
Do not claim that direct exhaustiveness solves complete-definition extraction; that remains a separate tested contract.
Inspect failures against exact source and field license; preserve originals and record corrections as new versions.
